en: An old black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a substantial villa-like building with a steep tiled roof and curving gables, seen from the street behind an ornate metal fence and low wall. The architecture is early‑20th‑century Central European, with multiple chimneys, dormer windows, and arched windows on the façade. Printed German text in red appears at the top of the image identifying the location and function of the building.
